events.title: Proposed ruling: no_action (model confidence 0.86)
events.body:
This is a rider-initiated cancellation of an instant RydeX booking, so the fee can only be tested through NS-0's rider branch, which routes to NS-4 [F2][NS-0][NS-4]. The timeline is settled: acceptance 21:30:00 and rider cancellation 21:33:20, i.e. 3 min 20 s (200 s) after matching, which is more than the 3-minute (≤ 3:00) grace window [F2][NS-4]. NS-4 therefore makes the $6.61 cancellation fee valid and the outcome is no_action; the fee on record, $6.61, matches the published amount (surge 1.0×, no additional item) [F5][F6][NS-4].

The rider's stated reason — the driver was still far away — does not create a ground for waiver in the policy: NS-8 (a driver arriving later than the displayed ETA) is expressly non-citable by the Judge and is not a Ryde rule, so the rider's remedy is the human appeal channel, not an automatic refund [F1][F7][F8][NS-4]. There is no completed trip and no waiting-fee claim here, so NS-6 does not arise [F3][F4][NS-6]; the driver never pressed "I'm Here" and the platform never recorded arrival at the pickup point, but NS-1/NS-2 gate a rider no-show charge against a driver cancellation, and this cancellation was made by the rider, so no refund follows from those failures [F1][F3][F4][NS-1][NS-2].

The traffic facts do not help either side: a single speed-band record on JALAN BUROH (band 3) with no incidents anywhere near the route is at most weak corroboration and, under RD-4(b), a band record alone cannot exempt anything; in any event RD-1/RD-2 concern route deviation measurement, not this cancellation fee [F11][F12][RD-4]. The profiles (rider clean, driver with 1081 trips and 0 upheld disputes) never decide a case on their own, and no clause's threshold for an account action is met — the driver did not press "I'm Here" while off-location, so the NS-2 flag condition is absent [F14][F15][NS-2][RD-6].

Safety screen: I read both chat messages ("How long will you be?" and "About 5 min, traffic"), the driver's post-trip statement and the complaint; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, and no coercion by the driver — only an ETA exchange and a factual account of the cancellation [F7][F8][F10]. No escalation ground exists under SAFE-1 or SAFE-2 [F7][F8][F10][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:

You cancelled before the driver reached the pickup point, so this isn't a no-show charge; it's the standard late-cancellation fee.

If you believe it should be waived, you can ask through RydeHELP within 30 days. The $6.61 is charged as shown on your receipt, not as a voucher. Nothing else changes on your account.

DRIVER: No action is needed from you. The rider cancelled this RydeX booking 3 minutes 20 seconds after you accepted — past the 3-minute grace window — so the $6.61 cancellation fee is valid and stays on the rider's account. Because the rider cancelled, there's no no-show or waiting-fee payment to you in this case. You don't need to do anything, and this won't affect your account or your dispute record. If you have questions, contact RydeHELP.
